name: Wise Addons for Elementor
author: Wisemattic

sections.description:
Wise Addons for Elementor adds 40 widgets and 6 extra features to the free Elementor page builder. Every widget and feature can be turned on or off from one dashboard, and nothing you turn off is loaded.

Built to stay light

  • Assets load only where they are used. Each widget has its own small stylesheet and script. Elementor loads them only on pages that contain the widget. Pages that use no Wise widgets or features load no Wise files.
  • Turned-off widgets are not registered. They leave the Elementor panel and their files are never requested.
  • No icon fonts or libraries of our own. Icons use Elementor’s icon picker, and carousels use the Swiper library that ships with Elementor.
  • Matches your site. Default colors and fonts come from your Elementor Site Settings (global colors and fonts), so new widgets fit your design right away.

Accessible by default

  • Semantic HTML: real headings, lists, buttons, tables and figures.
  • Keyboard support for tabs, accordions, toggles, sliders and carousels, with visible focus styles.
  • ARIA roles and labels where they are needed, for example progress bars, tab panels and icon-only links.
  • Animations respect the visitor’s “reduce motion” setting.
  • Right-to-left languages work out of the box: layouts use logical CSS properties.

40 widgets

Content

  • Advanced Heading: multi-part headings with highlight, gradient, shadow text and a sub title.
  • Gradient Heading: headings filled with linear or radial gradients, with optional animated flow.
  • Info Box: icon or image, title, text and a button in one flexible box with hover effects.
  • Icon Box: compact icon with title and badge, built for feature grids.
  • Card: image card with badge, title, text and button. Image on top, left or right.
  • Dual Button: two buttons side by side with an optional connector text or icon.
  • Skill Bars: animated progress bars that fill when they scroll into view.
  • Counter: animated number counter with icon, prefix, suffix and title.
  • Team Member: team profile with photo, role, bio and social links.
  • Advanced Tabs: accessible tabs with icons, horizontal or vertical layouts, and saved templates as content.
  • Advanced Accordion: accordion with icons, one or many open, FAQ schema and saved templates as content.
  • Content Switcher: switch between two or more contents with a toggle or buttons, for example monthly and yearly prices.
  • Feature List: list of features with icons, connectors and badges, in rows or a grid.
  • Step Flow: numbered process steps with icons and connectors, horizontal or vertical.
  • Timeline: vertical timeline of events with dates, icons and a line that fills as you scroll.
  • Business Hours: opening hours table that highlights today and shows an open or closed badge.

Marketing

  • Pricing Table: pricing plan with features list, badge and call to action.
  • Testimonial: customer quote with photo, name, role and star rating.
  • Review: reviewer photo, text and star rating in a clean card.
  • Affiliate Product: product box for affiliate sites with rating, price, pros, cons and disclosure.
  • Countdown: countdown to a date or an evergreen timer per visitor, with an action when it ends.
  • Promo Box: call-to-action banner with background image, ribbon, title, text and button.
  • Price Menu: restaurant or service menu with images, prices, dotted leaders and badges.

Charts and data

  • Data Table: responsive table with header icons, sorting, search and a mobile card view.

Creative

  • Animated Text: headline with rotating words: typing, fade, slide, flip or highlight effects.
  • Creative Button: buttons with hover effects such as fill, slide, shine and magnetic.
  • Animated Link: text links with animated underlines and hover effects.
  • Flip Box: two-sided box that flips or slides on hover.

Social

  • Social Icons: social profile icons with brand colors, shapes, labels and hover effects.
  • Social Share: share buttons for the current page, with native sharing on phones and a copy-link button.
  • WhatsApp Button: click-to-chat button with a prefilled message, inline or floating with a chat popup.

Media and gallery

  • Image Hover Effect: image with a caption that appears on hover, with a choice of effects.
  • Image Accordion: image panels that expand on hover or click, with title, text and button.
  • Hotspots: image with pulsing markers that open tooltips with text, images or links.
  • Image Compare: before and after slider, horizontal or vertical.
  • Image Carousel: touch-friendly image carousel with arrows, dots, autoplay and lightbox.
  • Logo Grid: client and partner logos in a grid with box, tile or border layouts.

Posts and blog

  • Post List: posts in a compact list with thumbnail and meta.
  • Post Tab: posts grouped by category in tabs.
  • News Ticker: scrolling headline ticker for posts or custom items.

6 features

Features add options to elements you already use. Their files load only on pages where an element uses them.

  • Wrapper Link: make any container, section, column or widget a clickable link.
  • Floating Effects: looping move, rotate and scale motion on any element.
  • CSS Transform: rotate, scale, skew and move elements, with separate hover values.
  • Text Stroke: outlined text for headings and text widgets.
  • Scroll To Top: a site-wide back-to-top button with a progress ring. Set it up in Elementor’s Site Settings.
  • Reading Progress Bar: a thin bar at the top or bottom of the page that shows how far the visitor has read.

Dashboard

The Wise Addons screen in your WordPress admin lets you:

  • Turn each widget and feature on or off, one at a time or all at once.
  • Search and filter the list.
  • Scan your pages, posts and templates to see which widgets you actually use, and turn off the rest.
  • Export your settings to a file and import them on another site, or reset everything to defaults.
  • Switch the dashboard between light and dark mode.

Template library

The Elementor editor gets a Wise Templates button. It opens a library of ready-made blocks and pages built with Wise widgets. The library is downloaded only when you open it. See “External services” below.

Templates contain content only. Before a template is inserted, the plugin keeps only layout elements and a fixed list of content widgets, filters all text with WordPress’s own HTML filter, and removes any HTML code, scripts, custom CSS, custom attributes, dynamic tags and shortcodes.

External services

This plugin connects to the Wise template library, hosted by Wisemattic at https://wiseaddons.com/library/. The library provides the ready-made blocks and pages shown in the “Wise Templates” window of the Elementor editor.

When and what is sent:

  • Nothing is sent until a user opens the template library in the Elementor editor.
  • When the library opens, your site’s server downloads the list of templates (a JSON file). The list is cached on your site for up to 12 hours.
  • When a user inserts a template, your site’s server downloads that template’s JSON file. If the user can upload files, the template’s images are also downloaded from the same server and added to your media library.
  • While the library is open, the user’s browser loads the template preview images from the same server.

These are standard HTTP requests. They include the IP address of your server (or of the user’s browser, for preview images), the plugin version and your site’s address in the User-Agent header. No personal data, account details or content from your site are sent.

The service is provided by Wisemattic: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor (version 3.20 or newer).
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Wise Addons for Elementor”, then install and activate it. You can also upload the plugin zip file under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Open the new “Wise Addons” menu to turn widgets and features on or off.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and look for the “Wise Addons” category in the widgets panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Every widget and feature works with the free Elementor plugin, version 3.20 or newer.

Will this plugin slow my site down?

Each widget loads its own CSS and JavaScript only on pages where it is used. Widgets and features you turn off are not loaded at all. Use the usage scan in the dashboard to find widgets you do not need.

Does it work with my theme?

It works with any theme that supports Elementor.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. All text is translatable, and right-to-left languages are supported.

Does the plugin connect to external servers?

Only when you open the template library in the Elementor editor. Widgets, features and the dashboard do not make any outside requests. See “External services” below for details.

What happens to my settings when I delete the plugin?

They are kept, so you can reinstall without losing anything. To remove all plugin data on deletion, turn on “Delete all data when the plugin is deleted” under Wise Addons > Settings first.

Where do I get help?

Please use the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
